mergedParams.userDescription: Text characters following a smooth motion path.

prompts.prompt: Create a preset that animates individual text characters along a smooth curved path, like a roller coaster ride. Each character should follow the same path but with a staggered delay, creating a wave-like motion as if the letters are cars on a track. Think of it as a video editing technique where you keyframe each letter's position along a bezier curve, similar to how you'd animate a title sequence in After Effects. The path should be visually smooth and organic, perhaps following a sine wave or figure-8 pattern. Characters should maintain their upright orientation as they travel (no rotation), creating a playful, bouncing effect. Consider adding subtle ease-in-out timing to make the motion feel natural and weighted.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with absolute positioning and a TextAtom for each character. Split the input text into individual characters and create a separate TextAtom for each. Calculate path positions using CSS custom properties or inline styles with transform: translate(). Use generic effects with AnimationRange[] to define keyframes for translateX and translateY properties. Apply cubic-bezier easing (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for smooth motion. Stagger start times by 0.1-0.2 seconds per character. Container should use 'relative w-full h-full' classes. Each character TextAtom should use 'absolute' positioning. Consider using an internal effect preset for the path motion that can be reused. Duration should be 3-5 seconds total with fitDurationTo: 'self'. Use will-change: transform for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Design a cinematic text animation where characters flow along an invisible motion path that resembles handwriting or calligraphy strokes. Imagine filming someone writing in the air with a sparkler - the characters should appear to be drawn along this glowing trail. Each letter should fade in as it reaches its position on the path, with a subtle glow effect that pulses once it's in place. The motion should feel elegant and deliberate, like a signature being signed. Add a slight rotation to each character as it moves, as if it's being 'written' into existence. This is similar to a write-on effect in video editing but with characters traveling through space rather than just appearing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout container using 'relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full bg-black' classes. Use TextAtom components for individual characters with 'absolute text-white' base styling. Implement a bezier path using SVG path data converted to x,y coordinates. Apply generic effects combining opacity (0 to 1), translateX/Y following path coordinates, rotate (-5 to 5 degrees), and a custom glow effect using textShadow. Use spring easing for organic motion feel. Create an internal effect preset called 'glow-pulse' that combines textShadow animation. Stagger timing with 0.15s delays between characters. Total duration 4-6 seconds. Consider adding a subtle blur effect (2px to 0) as characters appear. Use transform-gpu class for hardware acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Build a dynamic typography preset where text characters follow a physics-based motion path, as if they're floating bubbles or balloons drifting upward in a gentle breeze. Each character should have its own subtle variation in the path - some drift left, some right, creating an organic, non-uniform movement pattern. Think of this as layering multiple motion tracks in a video editor, each with slightly different keyframe curves. The characters should also scale up slightly as they rise, creating a sense of depth and dimension. Add a gentle rotation to simulate the natural tumbling of lightweight objects in air.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-visible' as container. Generate TextAtom components for each character with unique effect arrays. Create base path using sine wave function with randomized amplitude/frequency per character. Apply generic effects for: translateY (positive to negative values for upward motion), translateX (sine wave lateral drift), scale (1.0 to 1.3), rotate (0 to 360 degrees over duration), opacity (0.7 to 1.0). Use ease-out timing for natural deceleration. Implement using helper function to calculate unique paths. Duration 5-7 seconds with fitDurationTo: 'self'. Add 'transform-gpu will-change-transform' to each TextAtom. Consider using repeatChildrenProps for efficient prop distribution.

prompts.prompt: Create an audio-reactive text animation where characters dance along a waveform-inspired motion path. Imagine syncing text movement to music beats in a video editor - characters should 'jump' or 'pulse' along the path in response to audio intensity. The baseline path should be a smooth wave, but characters deviate from it based on audio data, creating a visualization effect. When bass hits, characters might jump higher; during quiet moments, they follow the path more closely. This combines motion graphics with audio visualization techniques, like creating a music video title sequence.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-purple-900 to-black'. Use TextAtom for each character with waveform effects enabled. Implement base sine wave path with generic effects for translateX/Y. Layer waveform effects on top: scale effect reacting to bass (threshold: 0.7, sensitivity: 1.5), translateY reacting to overall waveform (sensitivity: 2.0). Use audio analysis API via fetcher to get beat data if audio source provided. Create smooth base motion with ease-in-out, then add reactive 'bounce' with spring easing. Stagger character animations by 0.05s. Duration matches audio or 4-6 seconds default. Include 'animate-pulse' class for subtle base animation. Consider adding glow effect that intensifies with audio.

prompts.prompt: Develop a retro arcade-style preset where text characters follow a pixelated, stepped motion path reminiscent of 8-bit game animations. Instead of smooth curves, characters should move in discrete jumps along a grid-based path, like Pac-Man navigating a maze. Each 'step' should be instantaneous (no easing), creating that classic video game feel. Add a subtle flicker or strobe effect to enhance the retro aesthetic. Think of this as recreating the movement patterns from vintage arcade game title screens, where limited animation frames created distinctive motion styles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black pixelated' styling. Create grid-based coordinate system (e.g., 16x16 grid). TextAtom components should use 'absolute font-mono text-green-400' for retro terminal look. Implement stepped motion using linear easing with instant position changes at keyframes (no interpolation between grid positions). Create path as array of grid coordinates. Apply generic effects with many keyframes but linear/steps(1) timing between them. Add opacity flicker effect (1.0 to 0.8) at 10Hz frequency. Consider using custom CSS with image-rendering: pixelated. Duration 3-4 seconds, loop enabled. Use transform: translate3d() for positions to maintain pixel-perfect rendering.

prompts.prompt: Design a fluid, liquid-like text animation where characters flow along a path as if suspended in water or honey. The motion should have momentum and inertia - when changing direction, characters should ease into the turn with a subtle overshoot, then settle. Imagine keyframing with bezier handles in a video editor to create that viscous, syrup-like movement quality. Add subtle scaling that makes characters appear to 'breathe' or pulse as they move. The path itself should be organic and flowing, perhaps resembling ocean currents or wind patterns.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-radial from-blue-900/50 to-transparent'. Use TextAtom for each character with 'absolute text-white mix-blend-screen' for ethereal look. Implement smooth spline path using Catmull-Rom interpolation for natural curves. Apply generic effects with custom cubic-bezier easing (0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for elastic overshoot. Combine translateX/Y for path following, scale (0.9 to 1.1 to 0.9) for breathing effect, and subtle rotate for flow direction. Add slight blur effect (0 to 1px to 0) synchronized with scaling. Stagger timing with overlap (start + duration * 0.3 for each character). Duration 6-8 seconds. Use will-change: transform, filter for smooth animation.

prompts.prompt: Create a spiraling helix text animation where characters orbit around an invisible cylinder, like DNA strands or a spiral staircase. From a video editing perspective, this is similar to using 3D text on a path in After Effects, but implemented with 2D transforms. Characters should maintain consistent spacing as they spiral upward/outward, with those in the 'back' of the spiral appearing smaller and slightly faded to simulate depth. The motion should be hypnotic and continuous, perfect for loading screens or ambient displays.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full perspective-1000 preserve-3d' for 3D context. Calculate helix path using parametric equations: x = radius * cos(t), y = vertical_step * t, z = radius * sin(t). Use TextAtom components with dynamic z-index based on z-position. Apply generic effects for translateX/Y (from calculated path), scale (0.7 to 1.3 based on z-depth), opacity (0.6 to 1.0 based on z-depth). Use transform-style: preserve-3d on container. Implement continuous rotation with linear timing for smooth motion. Consider using CSS custom properties for radius and pitch adjustments. Duration 8-10 seconds, loop enabled. Add 'backface-visibility-hidden' to prevent flickering.

prompts.prompt: Build a constellation-style text animation where characters connect via motion paths that draw themselves like shooting stars. Each character starts at a random position, then travels along a straight or gently curved path to its final position, leaving a trailing light effect. Think of it as animating a network diagram or star map in a video editor - the paths should feel deliberate and meaningful, as if the characters are finding their place in a larger pattern. Add subtle twinkle effects once characters reach their destination.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-950 to-black overflow-hidden'. Create TextAtom for each character with random initial positions using Math.random(). Generate paths as straight lines or subtle arcs to final positions. Implement trail effect using multiple semi-transparent copies of each character with decreasing opacity and slight position offset. Apply generic effects: translateX/Y (from start to end position), opacity (0 to 1), scale (0.5 to 1.0). After reaching position, add subtle 'twinkle' using internal effect preset with opacity and scale pulsing. Use ease-out timing for deceleration effect. Stagger start times randomly between 0-1 second. Total duration 3-5 seconds. Consider adding subtle glow with textShadow.

prompts.prompt: Design a magnetic field text animation where characters are attracted to and repelled from invisible force points along their path. Imagine placing magnets on a video timeline that influence text movement - characters speed up when attracted, slow down when repelled, and curve their paths around these force fields. The result should feel dynamic and unpredictable, like iron filings responding to magnets. Add subtle rotation that aligns with the direction of movement, and vary character sizes based on their 'distance' from force points.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' container. Implement force field simulation using helper functions to calculate attraction/repulsion vectors. Define 2-3 force points with position and strength properties. For each TextAtom character, calculate path by combining base trajectory with force field influences. Use generic effects with many keyframes (30-60fps equivalent) for smooth physics simulation. Apply translateX/Y based on calculated positions, rotate to match movement angle using Math.atan2, scale based on distance to nearest force point (inverse relationship). Use spring easing for natural physics feel. Duration 4-6 seconds. Add 'pointer-events-none select-none' to prevent interaction. Consider using requestAnimationFrame simulation in presetExecution for complex calculations.

prompts.prompt: Create an orbital text carousel where characters follow an elliptical motion path around an invisible center point, like planets orbiting a sun. From a video editor's view, this is similar to using a 3D camera orbit but achieved with 2D transforms. Characters on the 'far' side of the orbit should appear smaller and move slower (parallax effect), while those on the 'near' side are larger and faster. Add a subtle tilt to the orbital plane to create more visual interest. The motion should be smooth and continuous, perfect for hero sections or feature highlights.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center perspective-800'. Calculate elliptical path using parametric equations with adjustable eccentricity. Create TextAtom for each character evenly distributed along the orbit. Apply generic effects for: translateX/Y (ellipse coordinates), scale (0.6 to 1.4 based on y-position for depth), opacity (0.7 to 1.0 for atmospheric perspective), rotateY (slight 3D rotation for facing direction). Use z-index or order based on y-position for proper layering. Implement different speeds per character using duration multipliers based on starting position. Add 'transform-gpu will-change-transform' for smooth 60fps animation. Duration 10-15 seconds, loop enabled. Consider using CSS custom properties for orbit parameters (radiusX, radiusY, tilt).
